title: RadRef: A Reference-Free Metric for Radiology Report Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13168v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-generated radiology reports are usually evaluated by comparison with a radiologist-authored reference, leaving no way to score them when no reference exists. We introduce RadRef, a reference-free metric that scores report claims against image-derived beliefs over a clinical finding vocabulary, weighted by relevance to the clinical indication. On ReXVal, RadRef achieves 73.1% agreement on non-tied same-radiograph report pairs with radiologist rankings, comparable to leading reference-based metrics overall. It is also competitive on false findings and has its clearest relative result on omissions (missed findings). We further evaluate 100 model-generated and 100 radiologist-authored reports from 100 MIMIC-CXR studies, all independently annotated by two board-certified radiologists. On omissions, RadRef attains Kendall's tau-b = 0.295, against 0.386 between the two readers themselves, and no compared metric differs significantly from Rad

translated_title: RadRef：一种用于放射学报告生成的无参考评估指标
translated_abstract: AI生成的放射学报告通常通过与放射科医生撰写的参考报告进行比较来评估，当没有参考报告时便无法对其进行评分。我们提出了RadRef，这是一种无参考评估指标，它在临床发现词汇表上，将报告中的陈述与从图像推导出的信念进行比对评分，并根据与临床适应症的相关性进行加权。在ReXVal数据集上，RadRef在非并列的同影像报告对上与放射科医生排名的一致性达到73.1%，总体上与领先的基于参考的指标相当。它在假阳性发现方面也具有竞争力，而在遗漏（漏诊发现）方面的相对表现最为突出。我们进一步评估了来自100项MIMIC-CXR研究的100份模型生成报告和100份放射科医生撰写的报告，这些报告均由两位经过委员会认证的放射科医生独立标注。在遗漏方面，RadRef达到Kendall's tau-b = 0.295，而两位放射科医生之间的一致性为0.386，且没有任何被比较的指标与RadRef存在显著差异。
tldr: 提出了RadRef，一种无需参考报告的放射学报告生成评估指标，通过将报告陈述与图像推导的临床发现信念进行比对评分，在遗漏发现评估上与放射科医生排名高度一致，解决了无参考报告时无法评估的问题。
en_tdlr: RadRef is a reference-free metric for radiology report generation that scores report claims against image-derived clinical findings, achieving radiologist-ranking agreement comparable to leading reference-based metrics, with its strongest performance on omissions.
